messages:
maria: Heads-up — legal asked for a 'signed bundle' download flow for audit exports (full tenant bundles). They want an easy console button + an export package that is integrity-signed with a manifest.sig and human-readable summary.
aj: +1. Do we mean a single zip that contains NDJSON + manifest.sig + a small index.html?
rafael: yes, that's what they sketched. Also want TTL links and an access audit event emitted when someone downloads.
lisa: UX Q: should the console show a size estimate and queue position before creating the bundle? most of these are heavy and we have quota/backpressure concerns.
maria: we should. legal will lose it if it says "preparing" for 20m with no hint. small progress indicator + estimated size.
chris: infra note — generating full-tenant bundles is IO heavy. we should spawn batch jobs and surface a presigned S3 multi-part URL once ready. quota enforcement needs to live in the export job scheduler.
aj: can we attach a small lease that counts against the tenant's export quota while preparing? that prevents spike storms.
rafael: yes, a soft-lease + final charge. if they cancel, we refund soft-lease credit. charge only on completed download.
lisa: console copy idea: "Create signed bundle (includes integrity signature + manifest) — estimated 4.2GB; uses 10 export credits". then CTA: Create / Cancel.
maria: telemetry: emit events: export.created, export.ready, export.downloaded, export.failed with tenant_id, bundle_size_est, credits_consumed, route_policy (hosting/dedicated/private). we need trace id for correlate.
chris: +1 for trace id. also include whether manifest was signed by KMS or HSM, we need that for compliance trace.
rafael: signing flow: after the job completes we create a manifest.json and call KMS.sign(manifest) -> manifest.sig. We store manifest and signature in bucket alongside the bundle.
aj: security: presigned URL should be one-time use and limited lifetime. also require the downloader to be in the same org network? legal asked for IP/VC restrictions — optional flag.
lisa: UX: add a "restrict download by IP" toggle with a tooltip: "optional compliance restriction; may increase latency for remote users".
chris: scalability: we should cap simultaneous heavy-export jobs per-region. propose per-tenant concurrency limit + global burst queue. if queue depth > N, surface a message: "High load — estimated start: ~12m".
rafael: and emit backpressure telemetry: export.queued_until and export.queue_position to monitor SLA misses.
maria: question for platform: what should we display in Console's audit timeline when someone requests a bundle? "Requested export (pending)" vs "Bundle prepared" vs "Downloaded by X" — want all three.
aj: also add a link to the signed manifest and an "Verify signature" helper in-console that fetches manifest.sig and verifies with stored pubkey.
chris: we can compute a short verification badge (green/yellow/red) based on signature validity and KMS status. good for legal.
lisa: copy for timeline entry: "User A requested signed audit bundle (4.2GB). Status: pending. Queue pos: 3." Keep it short.
rafael: API shape (proposal): POST /v1/exports/signed-bundle { tenant_id, range, restrict_by_ip?: [cidr], notify_emails?: [], storage_class?: 'hot'|'cold' } -> 202 accepted, returns job_id. GET /v1/exports/signed-bundle/{job_id} -> { status, estimated_size, queue_position, presigned_url? }
aj: ensure GET returns presigned_url only when status == ready. also response must include signature_meta: { method: 'kms', key_id, signature_algo } (we'll encode as headers in final bundle).
maria: rollout plan: beta to 5 pilot tenants on dedicated and private first, then hosted. console flag gated by org tier.
chris: infra-bot: scheduled export worker pool scaling + storage GC for bundles older than X days.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: export-worker-pool-scalers v1 -> rollout start 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC.
lisa: monitoring: dashboards: export queue length (per-region), median prepare time, 95th download latency, failures by error_type, KMS signing latency. Add an alert if avg prepare time > 10m for 95th percentile.
rafael: ops playbook: if signing fails for >3 jobs in 10m, auto-fail subsequent jobs with clear error advising to check KMS.
maria: edge case: tenant requests 'full history' but we only keep 90d by default. Console should show retention warning and include redaction summary in manifest.
aj: manifest should include field: "retention_applied": true/false and list of filters applied. helpful for legal.
chris: cost calc: we should estimate credits before creation based on rows * avg_token_size. add a backend estimator that runs quick sampling.
lisa: final UI: small modal, estimated size/credits, IP restriction toggle, checkbox "Sign with customer-managed key" (if customer on Private with HSM).
maria: ok next steps: rafael — draft API + manifest schema. chris — scheduler + quota enforcement sketch. lisa — UI mocks and copy. aj — telemetry + console timeline shape. I'll sync with legal after we have a prototype.
rafael: will do. ping me when done, I'll run sample packaging locally.
aj: I'll add telemetry events to the spec.
chris: I'll add queue metrics to the infra dashboard.
maria: thanks all — let's review early next week. :thumbsup:
